# Metadata wide_table_nullable_analysis

```{tags} reference, query-template, metadata_primitives
```

> [Metadata](../../metadata-primitives.md) benchmark · [all Metadata queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT
    table_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN is_nullable = 'YES' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nullable_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN is_nullable = 'NO' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS not_null_count,
    COUNT(*) AS total_columns
FROM information_schema.columns
WHERE table_name LIKE 'benchbox_wide_%'
GROUP BY table_name;
```
